message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test_only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set timezone
        uses: szenius/set-timezone@v1.0
        with:
          timezoneLinux: "Asia/Shanghai"

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: 1.25.5

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Go mod tidy
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Unit tests
        run: go test -coverprofile=cover_no.out ./...

      - name: Clean cover_no.out
        run: rm ./cover_no.out

  test_cover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set timezone
        uses: szenius/set-timezone@v1.0
        with:
          timezoneLinux: "Asia/Shanghai"

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: 1.26.4

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Go mod tidy
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Unit tests
        run: go test -coverprofile=cover.out ./...

      - name: Upload coverage reports to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        with:
          files: cover.out",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Go project with go.mod/go.sum and two test jobs that repeatedly run `go mod tidy` and `go test`, so dependency fetching is a repeatable, measurable cost. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) and the matching Go modules experiment (actions/cache@v4 on ~/go/pkg/mod keyed by runner.os and hashFiles('go.mod','go.sum')) support adding a dependency cache with all required checks preserved. No existing cache exists in the workflow, and the change adds only a cache step before `go mod tidy` in both jobs without removing tests, coverage upload, or altering permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}

The pattern `P-LIT-GHA-CACHE` has:
- preconditions: ["Repeated dependency fetching is measurable", "Cache inputs include lockfile and environment"]
